status: Frozen proposed design; correctness preflight passed; performance and memory experiments NOT executed
preregistration: Private computational plan after examining phase-two results; not public preregistration or an independent confirmatory sample
scope: Marginal bookkeeping costs at fixed occurrence-level skiplist semantics; grouped policy is an explicitly coupled secondary comparison

selection_rationale.grid_8100: High duplicate pressure and large prior combined-repair gain
selection_rationale.geometric_8192: Mostly distinct numeric keys; prior repair showed little query-time gain
selection_rationale.ny: Large real integer graph and large historical-retention footprint
selection_rationale.sparse_2048__lopsided: Frozen-advisor saturation/collision stress, not a realism claim

common_components: Frozen phase-two bitmap rank index and original skiplist methods
Original valRank per-occurrence lists in all four occurrence arms
Same scalar-distance to LIFO-vertex routing kernel
Same frozen linear advisor fitted from one common training-source heap trace
Same queue seed across methods within each block; seeds reset outside timers

cleanup.map: Delete sl.nodes[value] only after valRank[value] disappears, meaning the last live occurrence was extracted; retain node links

rank_bucket.linked: Doubly linked occurrence sequence plus value-to-deque handles; append order, tail hint and first-equal removal preserved

not_changed: No changes to sampling or comparison decisions

contrasts.identifies: Conditional implementation effect of deleting exhausted-key dictionary entries with original list buckets and unchanged search/height traces
contrasts.does_not_identify: Full immediate object reclamation, link detachment or duplicate grouping

contrasts.identifies: Same map-entry cleanup effect conditional on linked occurrence buckets
contrasts.does_not_identify: A universal cleanup effect independent of bucket implementation or garbage collection

contrasts.identifies: Net effect of occurrence-preserving direct removal, including added hashing, handles and allocation, conditional on retained history
contrasts.does_not_identify: Pure asymptotic removal savings with all other machine costs erased

contrasts.identifies: Same bucket-policy effect conditional on exhausted-key map cleanup
contrasts.does_not_identify: Duplicate compression; both arms retain one skiplist node per occurrence

contrasts.definition: (linked_map/list_map) / (linked_retain/list_retain), formed within a paired block before source aggregation
contrasts.identifies: Multiplicative interaction of these two concrete implementation changes on the measured workload
contrasts.does_not_identify: Independent main effects when the interaction is non-negligible

contrasts.identifies: Net difference between the existing grouped compact policy and a cleaned occurrence-preserving direct-bucket policy
contrasts.does_not_identify: Isolated duplicate grouping: live representative policy, node/height consumption, per-value metadata and link detachment also differ

validity_contract: Finite numeric keys and fixed deterministic monotone rank prediction; the original arbitrary-advice duplicate defects are not claimed repaired

preflight.purpose: Correctness/semantic preflight only; no performance measurements
preflight.validity_contract: Finite numeric priorities, frozen deterministic monotone ranks; original arbitrary-advice duplicate failures are not claimed repaired.

coupling_evidence.finding: An extracted newest duplicate may remain the value-to-node hint representative while an older equal key remains live. Clearing its links invalidates subsequent insertion. Original and map-only controls pass this trace.
coupling_evidence.interpretation: This is failure of our attempted transformation, not failure of the original queue on this trace

timing.processes: Fresh process per paired block; shuffled block and method order
timing.warmup: One validated warmup per method; warm RNG and class loading before measurement
timing.gc: Disable cyclic GC during query as in phase two; force collection before methods and record cleanup separately
timing.include: Queue construction, predictor lookup, shared routing and queue work
timing.exclude: Graph loading, oracle checks, training/build, diagnostic tracing and forced post-query collection
timing.outliers: No time-based filtering; preserve all failures and stop attribution if semantic parity fails

memory.source_subset: First training source and first far query for each of the four targets
memory.processes: Fresh process per target/method/GC mode; prewarm NumPy RNG and AST runtime before tracing
phases: empty queue alive before full collection
empty queue alive after full collection
memory.scope: Python traced allocations, graph/oracle excluded; record RSS high-water separately; never call a query-only peak whole-pipeline peak

bounded_live_diagnostic.keys: unique increasing values; isolates exhausted-key history from duplicate grouping

analysis.unit: Per-source median paired repetition ratios; six source units per target grouped by three training sources
analysis.intervals: Exploratory training-cluster bootstrap only; too few clusters for broad confirmatory inference
analysis.report: Every contrast, both clocks, each target separately; no universal winner or full factor attribution to grouping
analysis.stop_rule: Any output, hint, operand, live-node or height mismatch invalidates the corresponding clean ablation; preserve and investigate before performance claims

performance_runner: Not implemented or executed in this preparation task; runner must enforce this frozen plan before data collection
